_note: 校对：“与”翻译为 and 更自然，with 含义不符

en: Light | Lost on hit, replenished by picking up Lamp Oil. < 30 Dim: take more damage; 0 Out: lose 3 HP per second.
_zh: 灯火｜受击时损失，拾取灯油补充。< 30 暗淡：受到伤害更多；0 寂灭：每秒失去 3 点生命。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（lose 3 HP per second）

en: Nethersea Brand | Purple-black Nethersea Brand on the ground Slows and deals continuous damage, requires igniting a Guiding Beacon to cleanse.
_zh: 溟痕｜地面的紫黑色溟痕会减速并持续伤害，点燃引航灯标才能净化。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（damage），优化表达（requires igniting）

en: HP | If the Leader's HP reaches zero, the run fails. For each additional Operator in the squad, Max HP +{hp_per_member}%, recovery +{regen_per_member} / sec.
_zh: 生命｜队长生命归零即探索失败。编队每多一名干员，最大生命 +{hp_per_member}%、回复 +{regen_per_member} / 秒。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（recovery）

en: Bright | Light ≥ 70: SP Recovery +30%, Pick Up Range +20%. When Dim, damage taken +{dark_taken}%, Pick Up Range -30%, Seaborn movement speed and contact damage +{dark_enemy}%.
_zh: 通明｜灯火 ≥ 70：技力回复 +30%，拾取范围 +20%。暗淡时受到伤害 +{dark_taken}%，拾取范围 -30%，海嗣移速与接触伤害 +{dark_enemy}%。
_note: 校对：术语统一（移动速度 -> movement speed），修正大小写

en: Illuminated | Range radius varies between 110 and 360 with Light; when Light weakens, the ring shrinks but brightness remains unchanged. Enemies within the ring have damage taken +{lit_bonus}%, +{lit_bonus_hi}% when Bright.
_zh: 照亮｜范围半径在 110 与 360 之间随灯火变化，灯火变弱时圈缩小、亮度不变。圈内敌人受到伤害 +{lit_bonus}%，通明时 +{lit_bonus_hi}%。
_note: 校对：误译（随灯火变化应为 with Light 而非 and Light），修正大小写

en: Black Tide | From 2:30, the Safe Zone shrinks in 4 phases. Take continuous damage outside the zone. Move into the white dashed circle when 'Black Tide Approaching' appears.
_zh: 黑潮｜2:30 起安全区分 4 轮收缩，圈外持续受伤，看到「黑潮将至」就往白色虚线圈里走。

en: Disk | Press F (Controller LB, Touch 'Command' button) to open, select Formation and Targeting preference.
_zh: 圆盘｜按 F（手柄 LB，触屏「指挥」键）打开，选队形与索敌偏好。

en: Focus Fire | Bottom half of the disc. Select an Elite or Boss, all allies attack the target; mobs cannot be selected.
_zh: 集火｜圆盘下半圈。点选一名精英或 Boss，全队攻击该目标；小怪不能选。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（all allies attack）

en: Bonus | During Assault, Deploy, or Focus Fire, attacking allies gain ASPD +{cmd_aspd}% · SP recovery ×{cmd_sp}; no bonus during Follow, but allies will not take damage.
_zh: 加成｜突击、部署、集火时，出击的队友攻速 +{cmd_aspd}% · 技力回复 ×{cmd_sp}；随行时没有加成，但队友不会受伤。

en: Formation | Follow = Guard formation. Allies stay by Leader by class, taking no damage. Assault = Allies attack separately by class. Stamina lasts about {cmd_stamina}s, auto regroup when depleted. Lower half of disk: Deploy = Select a position for an ally to land. Defenders and Guards will block enemies.
_zh: 队形｜随行＝护卫阵型，队友按职业守在队长身边，不会受伤；突击＝队友按职业分头出击，耐力约 {cmd_stamina} 秒，耗尽自动归队。圆盘下半圈：部署＝点一个位置让队友落位，重装、近卫会挡住敌人。
_note: 校对：修正单复数（Allies, enemies），修正不必要的大写

en: Controls | Hold to select, release to confirm, tap to click; in-run time slows down when opened.
_zh: 操作｜按住选、松开确认，轻点则点选；打开时局内放慢。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（select, in-run）

en: Downed | Allies in Assault and Deploy can be injured by enemies and projectiles. Auto retreat to Leader when HP is below 30%. Downed when HP is depleted, reviving after {cmd_revive}s. Cooldown triggers when stamina is depleted, requiring {cmd_min}% to Assault again.
_zh: 倒地｜突击和部署中的队友会被敌人与弹幕打伤，生命低于 30% 自动撤回队长身边；生命耗尽即倒地，{cmd_revive} 秒后复活。耐力耗尽后冷却，回到 {cmd_min}% 才能再次突击。
_note: 校对：修正单复数（Allies, enemies, Auto retreat）

en: Aim | Normal attack fires automatically. Hold left click to fire toward cursor, push right stick on controller, or drag aim button on touchscreen; release to return to auto targeting.
_zh: 瞄准｜普攻自动出手。按住鼠标左键朝光标打，手柄推右摇杆，触屏拖动瞄准键；松开即回到自动索敌。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写，Touch 修正为 touchscreen

en: Position | Bottom of screen: Center is Leader with Ultimate (Q), left is HP, Light, Dash, right is allies and current command.
_zh: 位置｜屏幕正下方：中间是队长与终结技（Q），左边是生命、灯火、冲刺，右边是队友与当前指令。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写，修正单复数（allies）

en: Light | The gold bar below HP, value on the right; marks at 30 and 70.
_zh: 灯火｜生命下面的金色长条，右边是数值；30、70 处各有一道刻度。

en: Ultimate | The outer ring of the portrait is energy, turns cyan when full; percentage is below the portrait.
_zh: 终结技｜头像外圈是能量，满格转青；头像下是百分比。

en: Dash Charges | Arrows left of 'Dash': cyan means available, refills from bottom to top when used. 'Multi-Dash' stores one extra charge, 'Swift' reduces cooldown.
_zh: 冲刺格｜「冲刺」左边的箭头：青色可用，用掉后从下往上回填。「连冲」多存一格，「迅捷」缩短冷却。

en: Ally | The thin line under the portrait is HP; turns gray when downed, revives after the countdown ends.
_zh: 队友｜头像下的细线是生命；倒地时变灰，读秒结束后复活。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（downed）

en: Command Card | Current command: Follow, Assault, Deploy, Focus Fire. Assault and Deploy count time limit along the border; Focus Fire ends when the target is defeated.
_zh: 指令牌｜当前指令：随行、突击、部署、集火。突击、部署沿边框计作战时限；集火目标倒下即结束。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写

en: Appearance | 2:00, 5:00, 8:00. Stays for 60s only. Golden arrows at the screen edge point to him.
_zh: 出现｜2:00、5:00、8:00，只停留 60 秒，屏幕边缘的金色箭头指向他。

en: Purchase | Approach to buy Relics, First-aid Kits, and Lamp Oil with Originium Ingots.
_zh: 购买｜靠近即可用源石锭购买藏品、急救包与灯油。

en: Reminder | A banner reminder appears in the last 15s, and the countdown turns red. Can consume Originium Ingots to refresh stock once per visit (Press F).
_zh: 提醒｜最后 15 秒有横幅提醒，倒计时变红。每次到访可消耗源石锭刷新一次货架（按 F）。
_note: 校对：修正单复数（Originium Ingots），修正语法（refresh stock once）

en: Smelt | After the last merchant leaves, remaining and subsequently obtained Originium Ingots are automatically smelted into squad damage (+1% per 15 ingots, up to +20%).
_zh: 熔铸｜最后一位商人离开后，剩下的和之后获得的源石锭自动熔铸为全队伤害（每 15 枚 +1%，上限 +20%）。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（merchant, smelted, ingots）
校对：“与”翻译为 and 更自然，结局应为复数

en: Node Card | After clearing Ending 1, defeating the Mid-Boss reveals a node card. Ending routes are hidden in 'Encounter'.
_zh: 节点卡｜通关结局一后，中 Boss 打完会翻节点卡；结局线藏在「不期而遇」里。

en: Intersection | Flips once after all Mid-Bosses at 3:30 and 7:00 are defeated (latest 6:30 and 8:40). Three cards only reveal their type; select one to flip and it takes effect immediately.
_zh: 路口｜3:30、7:00 的中 Boss 全部倒下后各翻一次（最晚 6:30、8:40），三张卡只露类型，选一张翻开即生效。
_note: 校对：统一术语（Mid-Bosses），修正不必要的大写

en: Ending Route | Entrances to both Ending routes are guaranteed per run, but the event is unknown until revealed; for achieved Endings, the entrance card back is outlined in that Ending's color.
_zh: 结局线｜两条结局线的入口每局必有，但翻开前不知道是哪件事；达成过的结局，入口卡背描上该结局的颜色。

en: Route | Ending depends solely on tokens obtained. Current route is displayed below the Relic bar in the top right and on the Tab panel; endgame warning at 9:00.
_zh: 走向｜结局只看拿到的信物。当前走向显示在右上角藏品栏下方与 Tab 面板，9:00 有终局预告。

en: Ending | Four Endings each have a different Final Boss. Once achieved, they are added to the 'Ending' tab in Archive.
_zh: 结局｜四个结局各有不同的最终 Boss，达成后收录进图鉴「结局」分页。

en: Elite | Has a golden halo and HP bar. Drops Originium Ingots when defeated, with a chance to drop a chest. The 'Focus Fire' disc allows the whole squad to focus attacks on it.
_zh: 精英｜带金色光环与血条，击败掉落源石锭，有概率掉落宝箱。圆盘「集火」可以让全队集中攻击它。
_note: 校对：修正单复数（Originium Ingots），修正不必要的大写（chest）

en: Boss | Zone shrinking pauses when Mid-Boss is present, normal Seaborn spawn as usual; watch the warning circles on the ground, Dash to dodge, invincible during Dash.
_zh: Boss｜中 Boss 在场时暂停缩圈，普通海嗣照常刷新；看清地面的预警圈，冲刺躲开，冲刺中无敌。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（invincible）

en: Final Boss | Appears at 10:00. Other Seaborn will no longer spawn after its appearance. Defeat it to complete the run.
_zh: 最终 Boss｜10:00 登场，登场后不再刷新其他海嗣，击败它即完成探索。

en: Duck Lord | Does not attack, runs faster when attacked, and slips away if not defeated within 30s; defeated guarantees 1 Relic and a small amount of Originium Ingots.
_zh: 鸭爵｜不攻击，受到攻击后越跑越快，30 秒内没被击倒就会溜走；击倒必得 1 件藏品与少量源石锭。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（defeated），修正单复数（Originium Ingots）

_zh: 目标｜维持作战至 10:00，击败它们。

_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（arrow keys）

en: Dash | Space. Invincible during Dash, cooldown approx. {dash_cd}s.
_zh: 冲刺｜空格。冲刺中无敌，冷却约 {dash_cd} 秒。

en: Panel | Tab / C: Stats    Esc: Pause
_zh: 面板｜Tab / C：属性　　Esc：暂停

en: Ultimate | Q: Hold when energy is full to see range (target / direction follows mouse), release to cast; squad skills and Link are cast automatically.
_zh: 终结技｜Q：能量满后按住看范围（落点 / 方向类跟鼠标选），松开释放；全队技能与连携都自动释放。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Range），“全队技能”误译为 global Skill，应为 squad skills。

en: Aim | Normal attacks fire automatically; hold Left Click to attack toward cursor, release to return to auto targeting.
_zh: 瞄准｜普攻自动出手；按住鼠标左键时朝光标方向打，松开即回到自动索敌。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Normal Attack, Auto Targeting），且普攻应为复数。

en: Controller | Left Stick Move · Ⓑ / RT Dash · Ⓐ / RB Ultimate · Right Stick Aim · LB Command Disk · START Pause · SELECT Stats
_zh: 手柄｜左摇杆移动 · Ⓑ / RT 冲刺 · Ⓐ / RB 终结技 · 右摇杆瞄准 · LB 指挥圆盘 · START 暂停 · SELECT 属性

en: Other | M: Music  V: Speed  R: Restart
_zh: 其他｜M：音乐　　V：倍速　　R：重来

en: Press F (Controller LB, Touch 'Command' button) to open, select formation and targeting preference
_zh: 按 F（手柄 LB，触屏「指挥」键）打开，选队形与索敌偏好
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Select Formation, Targeting）。

en: Click right 'Command' button to open, select formation and targeting preference
_zh: 点右侧「指挥」键打开，选队形与索敌偏好
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Formation, Targeting）。

en: Press and hold to select, release to confirm, tap to click
_zh: 按住选、松开确认，轻点则点选

_note: 校对：不必要的大写，且选项在此处为单数。

en: Hold Left Click to attack towards the cursor, push Right Stick on Controller, drag aim button on touchscreen
_zh: 按住鼠标左键朝光标打，手柄推右摇杆，触屏拖动瞄准键
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Aim Button），Touch 表达触屏不地道，应为 touchscreen。

en: Hold aim button and drag to select direction
_zh: 按住瞄准键拖动选方向
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Aim Button）。
校对：语法错误（1 Times 应为 once），不必要的大写。
校对：语法错误（1 Times 应为 once），不必要的大写。
校对：“与”应译为 and，而不是 with。
校对：“与”应译为 and，而不是 with。

_zh: 目标｜维持作战至 10:00，击败它们。

en: Move | Press and hold left side of screen to drag
_zh: 移动｜按住屏幕左半边拖动

en: Dash | Bottom right 'Dash' button. Invincible during dash, cooldown approx {dash_cd}s.
_zh: 冲刺｜右下「冲刺」键。冲刺中无敌，冷却约 {dash_cd} 秒。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Dash Button, Dash）。

en: Command | Right 'Command' button opens the disk
_zh: 指挥｜右侧「指挥」键打开圆盘
_note: 校对：“圆盘”应统一译为 disk（与 p0 保持一致）。

en: Ultimate | Hold 'Ultimate' button on the bottom right when energy is full to see range, drag to select direction / target, release to cast; squad skills and Link are cast automatically
_zh: 终结技｜能量满后按住右下「终结技」键看范围，拖动选方向 / 落点，松手释放；全队技能与连携都自动释放
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Range），“全队技能”误译为 global Skill，应为 squad skills。

en: Panel | 'Pause' and 'Stats' buttons on the right; Upgrade / Chest / Merchant / Node Card: Tap card to select
_zh: 面板｜右侧「暂停」「属性」键；升级 / 宝箱 / 商人 / 节点卡：点击卡片选择

en: Aim | Normal attacks fire automatically; press and drag the aim button left of the 'Dash' button to change direction, release to return to auto targeting. Can be hidden in 'Touch Button Layout' when not in use
_zh: 瞄准｜普攻自动出手；冲刺键左侧的瞄准键按住拖动可改方向，松开即回到自动索敌。不用时可在「触屏按键布局」里隐藏
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Normal Attacks, Aim Button, Dash Button, Auto Targeting）。

en: The 'Guide' in the pause menu has full details. Good luck, Doctor.
_zh: 暂停菜单里的「指南」有完整说明。祝你好运，博士。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Pause Menu, Full Details）。

_zh: 玩过《吸血鬼幸存者》这类游戏吗？

en: Only view features unique to this game: squad, Link, Ultimate, Command, approx. 40s
_zh: 只看本作特有的：小队、连携、终结技、指挥，约 40 秒
_note: 校对：根据固定术语，squad 不应大写（除非句首）。

_zh: 先走一段约 1 分钟的演示局

en: Can be turned on again later in 'Settings · Controls'
_zh: 之后可在「设置 · 操作」里重新打开

en: WASD to move, Space to dash (invincible during dash), attacks fire automatically.
_zh: WASD 移动，空格冲刺（冲刺中无敌），攻击会自动打出去。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写，优化祈使句语法。

en: Hold and drag left half of screen to move, tap 'Dash' button to dash (invincible during dash), attacks fire automatically.
_zh: 按住左半屏拖动移动，点冲刺键冲刺（冲刺中无敌），攻击会自动打出去。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写，优化祈使句语法。
校对：“与”应译为 and，而不是 with。

en: Pick up EXP crystals, upgrade when the EXP bar is full, select 1 of 3 cards.
_zh: 拾取经验结晶，经验条满了就升级，三张卡里选一张。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Pick Up, Crystal, Upgrade, Select），crystal 应为复数。

en: Operator cards appear upon upgrade; select to join the squad. You control the Leader (the Operator selected upon departure); allies fight automatically.
_zh: 升级时会出现干员卡，选中即加入编队。你操控的是队长（出发时选的干员），队友自动作战。
_note: 校对：不必要的大写（Upgrade, Depart），Depart 词性错误应为 departure，Ally 漏了复数。
校对：“一名”译为 an 更自然，1 过于生硬。

en: Ultimate charged: Hold Q to view Range, release to cast.
_zh: 终结技已充满：按住 Q 看范围，松开释放。

en: Ultimate is fully charged: Hold Ultimate button to view Range, release to cast.
_zh: 终结技已充满：按住终结技键看范围，松开释放。

en: Ultimate is charged: Hold Q to view Range, release to cast.
_zh: 终结技充满了：按住 Q 看范围，松开释放。

en: Ultimate fully charged: Hold Ultimate button to view Range, release to cast.
_zh: 终结技充满了：按住终结技键看范围，松开释放。

en: Squad, Light, and Command are covered. Other content will be prompted in the top left when encountered for the first time.
_zh: 小队、灯火、指挥都讲完了，其余内容第一次遇到时会在左上角提示。

en: Can be reviewed anytime in 'Guide' in the Pause Menu.
_zh: 随时可在暂停菜单的「指南」里重看。

en: Taking hits reduces Light. Damage taken increases when Light is below 30; pick up Lamp Oil to replenish.
_zh: 受击会损失灯火，灯火低于 30 时受到的伤害更多；拾取灯油补充。
_note: 校对：修正大小写和语法（Hit -> Taking hits, Damage Taken -> Damage taken, Pick Up -> pick up）

en: Taking hits reduces Light. Damage taken increases when below 30; pick up Lamp Oil to replenish.
_zh: 受击会损失灯火，低于 30 时受到的伤害更多；拾取灯油补充。
_note: 校对：修正大小写和语法（Hit -> Taking hits, Damage Taken -> Damage taken, Pick Up -> pick up）

en: Merchant only stays for 60s. Follow the gold arrow to find him, use Originium Ingot to buy Relic.
_zh: 商人只停留 60 秒。跟着金色箭头找到他，用源石锭购买藏品。

en: Merchant only stays for 60s, follow the gold arrow to find him, use Originium Ingot to buy Relic.
_zh: 商人只停留 60 秒，跟着金色箭头找到他，用源石锭购买藏品。

en: Watch the warning circles on the ground, press Space to Dash and dodge, invincible during Dash.
_zh: 看清地面的预警圈，按空格冲刺躲开，冲刺中无敌。

en: Watch the warning circles on the ground, tap Dash Button to dodge, invincible during Dash.
_zh: 看清地面的预警圈，点冲刺键躲开，冲刺中无敌。

en: Safe Zone shrinking paused when Boss is present; watch for warning circles on the ground, press Space to Dash and dodge, invincible during Dash.
_zh: Boss 在场时暂停缩圈；看清地面的预警圈，按空格冲刺躲开，冲刺中无敌。
_note: 校对：修正标点符号和大小写（Press -> press, 句号改为逗号以匹配中文，Invincible -> invincible）

en: Safe Zone shrinking paused when Boss is present; watch for warning circles on the ground, tap Dash Button to dodge, invincible during Dash.
_zh: Boss 在场时暂停缩圈；看清地面的预警圈，点冲刺键躲开，冲刺中无敌。
_note: 校对：修正标点符号和大小写（句号改为逗号以匹配中文，Invincible -> invincible）

en: You control the Leader; if the Leader is defeated, the run fails. Allies follow the Leader and automatically battle.
_zh: 你操控的是队长，队长倒下即探索失败；队友跟着队长自动作战。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（Defeated, Follow, Auto）并优化表达

en: Leader defeat fails the run. Allies follow the Leader and automatically battle.

Pursues normally but does not bite during this time. Defeating it before the scream ends yields Originium Ingot ×1.5. Bites twice, second bite damage ×0.6. Immune to Stun, Cold, and Silence. Drops Originium Ingot when defeated.
_zh: 精英。伪装成补给箱，受到攻击后现形。现形后尖叫 2.5 秒：周围 150 内累积神经损伤并吞噬灯火，期间照常追击、不啃咬；尖叫结束前击倒，源石锭 ×1.5。啃咬两连，第二口伤害 ×0.6。免疫眩晕、寒冷和封印；击败后掉落源石锭。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（during, scream, damage, defeated），优化句子结构

en: Mid-Boss (3:30 / 7:00). Paves a path of life from its feet to the edge of the field, with a signpost at the end of each phase along the route. Leader running past a signpost severs the path, causing fractals on the path to stop and become priority attack targets. Stunned for 3s after all are severed. Act 1 signposts spit splitting fractal ammo to both sides, or release twice-forking branch ammo toward Leader. After HP drops to 50%, a ring of ammo closes in from the outside, with the gap on the path of life. Charge leaves a row of ammo pushed to both sides along the route. 'Charge' and 'Quake' are cast in sequence, revealing an opening after the moves.
_zh: 中期 Boss（3:30 / 7:00）。从脚下向场边铺生路，路线上每段末端有一个路标；队长跑过路标即截断这条路，路上的分形停下并成为优先攻击目标，全部截断后硬直 3 秒。一幕路标向两侧吐出会分裂的分形弹，或朝队长放出两次分叉的树枝弹；生命降到 50% 后，一圈弹从外向它收拢，缺口在生路上，冲撞沿线留下一排向两侧推开的弹。「冲撞」「震地」连续出招，收招后出现破绽。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（phase, attack, all, ammo, opening）；「震地」本表译 Earthshatter，这里没对上

en: Mid-Boss (7:00). Buffed state of Saint Carmen (same character, only one appears per run): higher HP and ATK, hand cannon only loads 1 shot. 'Hand Cannon' beam pierces fullscreen, 'Bombardment' arcs toward the Leader's position, both sharing ammo. Pursues in melee after emptying ammo, using 'Scatter' at close range to fire 2 waves of 18 pellets each. Reload takes 3s (2.6s in Act 2). Accumulating damage taken or being dashed through during the cast bar interrupts the action, forcing him to his knees and revealing an opening. Below 50% HP, after reload, first releases a 'Clear Chamber' notched loop, then follows with 'Hand Cannon · Triple Combo'.
_zh: 中期 Boss（7:00）。圣徒卡门的强化状态（同一人物，一次探索只会出现一位）：生命与攻击更高，手炮只装 1 发。「手炮」射线贯穿全屏，「轰击」曲射砸向队长所在位置，两者共用弹药；打空后近身追击，近距离用「散射」连喷 2 波、每波 18 发弹丸。装填 3 秒（第二幕 2.6 秒），读条中累计受到伤害或被冲刺穿身会被打断、跪地露出破绽。50% 后装填完毕先放「清膛」缺口环，再接「手炮·三连」。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（shot, fullscreen, ammo, melee, damage taken, dashed, opening, reload, l

en: Mid-Boss (3:30 / 7:00). Elderly 'Saint' wielding a hand cannon (same person as Iberia, only one appears in a run): 3 ammo. Long-range 'Snipe', melee 'Cannon Sweep'. Turns and 'Ring Shot' when ammo is full at medium range, emptying 3 shots at once into an ammo ring with three gaps. Reloads for 3s, cast bar can be interrupted. After 50%, emptying ammo triggers 8s of cannon melee, using 'Cannon Smash' to rush to Leader and smash the ground.
_zh: 中期 Boss（3:30 / 7:00）。持手炮的年迈圣徒（与伊比利亚是同一人物，一次探索只会出现一位）：3 发弹药。远距离「狙击」，近身「炮身横扫」；弹药满且距离适中时转身「环射」，三个缺口的弹环一次打空 3 发。装填 3 秒，读条可被打断。50% 后弹药打空先进入 8 秒炮身近战，用「炮身砸击」冲到队长身边砸地。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（ammo, melee, shots）；「狙击」本表译 Sniper，这里没对上

en: Mid-Boss (7:00). Appears paired with The Despicable or The Repugnant. Enters reviving state and recovers HP when HP reaches zero; both must be reviving simultaneously for true defeat. When the HP difference between the two is too large, the one with lower HP takes reduced damage. Both release projectiles, with barrages symmetrical along the midline between them: one fires in a fan shape and the other mirrors it, or both simultaneously release oppositely curved projectile loops. When either's HP drops to 50%, they swap positions every 10s, deploying a projectile wall along their connecting line that pushes outward to both sides, while both simultaneously release oppositely rotating spirals. The Bishop's 'Tidal Pillar' and its companion's melee attacks are executed in continuous succession; after the attacks conclude, both simultaneously reveal an opening.
_zh: 中期 Boss（7:00）。与蔑死体或斥亡体成对出现；生命归零后进入假死并回复，两者同时假死才会真正倒下。两具血量差过大时，血少的一具受到的伤害降低。两具各自放弹，弹幕关于两体之间的中线对称：一具扇射后另一具放镜像，或两具同时放出反向弯曲的弹环。任一具生命降到 50% 后，每 10 秒互换位置，连线上排出向两侧推开的弹墙，两具同时放反向螺旋。主教「潮汐柱」与同伴近战连续出招，收招后两具同时出现破绽。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（paired, reviving, defeat, loops, melee, opening），修正 damage taken 冗余

en: Tidelinked Bishop's companion. Sturdy melee Seaborn. Hits cause Corrosion. Also capable of reviving. 'Sweep' swings claws twice. 'Leap Strike' smashes Leader's position. 'Corrosive Tide Breath' hits increase Corrosion damage by +25% within 3s. When either HP drops to 50%, Leap Strike releases 'Shattertide' blade ring upon landing.
_zh: 接潮主教的同伴。粗壮的近战海嗣，命中附带侵蚀，同样会假死。「横扫」连挥两爪，「跃击」砸向队长所在位置，「蚀潮吐息」命中后 3 秒内侵蚀伤害 +25%；任一具生命降到 50% 后，跃击落地时放出「裂潮」刃环。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（melee, reviving, damage）

en: Tidelinked Bishop's companion. Swift melee Seaborn. Hits cause Corrosion. Also capable of reviving. 'Flurry' thrusts in 3 phases (4 phases after 50%), attacking in sequence with the Bishop's 'Tide Pillar'. Enrages and 'Bursts' when partner is reviving. Also 'Bursts' when reviving itself.
_zh: 接潮主教的同伴。迅捷的近战海嗣，命中附带侵蚀，同样会假死。「连斩」连续突刺 3 段（50% 后 4 段），与主教「潮汐柱」连续出招；搭档假死时狂暴并「迸发」，自己复苏时也会迸发。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（melee, reviving, phases），修正无中生有的 Al-Rafiq 为 partner

en: Final Boss of Ending 1 'Precious Days'. Seven active attacks: 'Gaze' aims beam sequentially; 'Overlapping Shadows' tracks Leader again each phase; 'Bubble Ring' ammo ring with gaps; 'Call' fan-shaped surge; 'Hunting Bubble' tracks briefly then travels straight; 'Phantom Encirclement' beam on both sides; 'Bubble Convergence' inward-closing bubble cluster, leaving an exit. Cognitive burden aura reduces all allies' ASPD. Falls when HP drops to half. Cocoons when HP first reaches zero, recovering to 50% Max HP when reviving.
_zh: 结局一「平凡即是喜乐」的最终 Boss。七种主动攻击：「凝视」依次瞄准的光束；「叠影」每段重新追踪队长；「泡影环」缺口弹环；「呼号」扇形喷涌；「追猎泡」短时追踪后直行；「幻影合围」两侧光束；「泡影收束」向内合拢的泡群，留有出口。认知负担光环降低全队攻速。生命降至一半时坠落，首次归零后结茧，复苏时恢复至最大生命的 50%。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（beam, phase, ammo, reviving），修正 All Ally 语法

en: Final Boss of Ending 4 'Stella Caerula'. Invincible during learning phase, offspring slowly approach the main body from the edges of the field; activates sharing after absorbing offspring. Elucidation phase executes attacks in continuous groups per act, revealing an opening at the end of each group: 'Tidal Crash', 'Deciphering Vortex', 'Share', 'Shock', 'Swarm-Guarding Tentacle', 'Migration Tide', 'Abyssal Upwelling', as well as oscillating water projectiles, offspring resonance, spiral projectile arms, learned projectiles that Halt before turning, and returning backflow projectiles. Water currents leave a path in the direction the offspring come from; offspring on the path will also release projectiles, and more absorption stacks result in more learned projectiles. Migration Tide crosses the field and leaves a path, while Upwelling forms an inwardly contracting ring. Shock and Act 3's Share · Global can be dodged by dashing or standing in an Illuminated Lamp Pillar Beacon Ring; Lamp Pillars do not block other projectiles.
_zh: 结局四「如星空般深蓝」的最终 Boss。学习阶段无敌，子代从场边缓慢靠近本体；吸收子代后发动分享。阐释阶段按幕成组连续出招，每组结束露出破绽：「潮汐坠落」「解读旋涡」「分享」「震撼」「护群触腕」「迁徙潮」「深渊涌流」，以及摆动的水流弹、子代共鸣、螺旋弹臂、停顿后转向的习得弹、卷回的回流弹。水流在子代来向留出通道；走在路上的子代会跟着放弹，吸收层数越多习得弹越多。迁徙潮横穿场地并留有通道，涌流形成向内收拢的环带。震撼与三幕的分享·全场可通过冲刺或站进点亮的灯柱光圈躲避，灯柱不挡别的弹。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（phase, opening, resonance, dashing）

en: Final Boss of Ending 3 'Price of Peace'. Untargetable during humanoid phase. Heals Seaborn and buffs them into Elites, marking buffed targets with a red outline. Three teardrops each sustain one Elite; touching a teardrop permanently cleanses it and removes the corresponding buff. Uncleansed teardrops accelerate transformation, becoming destructible Song Eyes after transforming. Hostile form has seven active attacks: 'Tearfall', 'Three-Line Sweep', 'Song of We Many', 'Bite', 'Chorus Volley', 'Chorus Encroachment', and 'Abyssal Tentacle'. Destroying Chorus Seaborn weakens Volley and Encroachment. Destroying Song Eyes interrupts teardrop resonance and removes the corresponding Elite buff.
_zh: 结局三「息潮的代价」的最终 Boss。人形阶段不受攻击，治疗海嗣并将其强化为精英，红色描边标记强化目标。三枚泪滴各维持一名精英；触碰泪滴可永久净化并解除对应强化。未净化的泪加快转化，转化后成为可破坏的歌眼。敌对形态有七种主动攻击：「泪落」「三线扫射」「大群之歌」「撕咬」「合唱齐射」「合唱压境」「深海触腕」。拆除合唱海嗣可削弱齐射与压境，击破歌眼可中断泪滴共鸣并解除对应精英强化。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（form, resonance）

en: Final Boss of Ending 2 'Age of the Silence'. Eight active attacks: 'Charge', 'Ice Line', 'Spear Flurry', 'Spear Throw', 'Spear Spin', 'Ice-Treading Formation Break', 'Tide-Severing Cleave', 'Side-Step Spear Thrust'. Ice Line is followed by Cold pursuit. Formation Break seals three paths. Cleave advances forward. Side-Step re-aims Spear Thrust. Phase 1 deploys five ice pillars, generating the next batch only after all are shattered. Reborn in ice when HP first reaches zero, remaining pillars shatter and no longer generate, Charge continues for three phases. Accumulated hits can trigger Cold counterattack.
_zh: 结局二「静谧时代」的最终 Boss。八种主动攻击：「冲锋」「冰线」「长枪连刺」「掷枪」「长枪回旋」「踏冰裂阵」「断潮劈击」「侧踏挑枪」。冰线后接寒冷追击，裂阵封锁三条通道，劈击向前推进，侧踏后重新瞄准挑枪。一阶段布置五根冰柱，全部撞碎后才生成下一批。首次生命归零后寒冰重生，残柱碎裂且不再生成，冲锋接续三段；累积受击可触发寒冷反击。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（three, all, phases），修正 Hit 为复数

en: Elite. The Last Knight, appears only after Tide-Hunt Knight (Ending 2 route) is defeated. Charges in a straight line, inflicting Frost Slow on hit.
_zh: 精英。最后的骑士，只在猎潮的骑士（结局二路线）倒下后出现。直线冲锋，命中附带冰霜减速。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（defeated）

en:
Not recruited.

Unlock with Headhunting Permit after run settlement.
_zh:
未招募。

探索结算后用寻访凭证解锁。
_note: 校对：修正不必要的大写（settlement）
校对：统一固定术语 movement speed

en: Hits deal brief Stagger. Consecutive hits have a protection interval.
_zh: 命中造成短暂僵直，连续命中有保护间隔。
_note: 校对：大小写修正，deal和interval不应大写

en: Not yet encountered. Archive after encountered.
_note: 校对：大小写修正，encountered在句中不应大写
校对：大小写修正，times不应大写

en: Not yet encountered. Archive after encountered.
_note: 校对：大小写修正，encountered不应大写

en: Drops from defeated enemies. Pick up to gain EXP.
_zh: 击败敌人掉落，拾取后获得经验。
_note: 校对：大小写修正，pick up和gain不应大写

en: Replenishes Light. Light has three levels: Bright (≥ 70) damage taken by enemies within Light Radius +%d%%, SP Recovery +30%%; Flickering (30–70) damage taken by enemies within Light Radius +%d%%; Dim (< 30) damage taken by Leader +5%%, Seaborn movement speed and contact damage +10%%, Seaborn outside the light ring are hard to see. When Light is Out (0), lose 3 HP per second.
_zh: 补充灯火。灯火分三档：通明（≥ 70）照亮范围内敌人受到的伤害 +%d%%，技力回复 +30%%；摇曳（30–70）照亮范围内敌人受到的伤害 +%d%%；暗淡（< 30）队长受到的伤害 +5%%，海嗣移速与接触伤害 +10%%，灯圈外的海嗣难以看清。灯火寂灭（0）时每秒失去 3 点生命。
_note: 校对：统一术语（movement speed），修正不必要的大写，修正“灯火寂灭”为Light is Out，修正复数和语法

en: Dropped by Elites, Bosses, and Chest Seaborn. Can be used to purchase Relics and Supplies from the Merchant. After the last Merchant leaves, remaining and subsequently obtained Originium Ingots will be smelted into squad damage.
_zh: 精英、Boss 与箱形恐鱼会掉落，可在商人处购买藏品与补给。最后一位商人离开后，剩余和之后获得的源石锭会熔铸为全队伤害。
_note: 校对：Seaborn本身即为复数，不加s；smelted不应大写

en: Absorbs all EXP Crystals, Lamp Oil, and Originium Ingots on the field when picked up. Low chance to drop from normal enemies; Elites and Bosses are guaranteed to drop a Magnet or Recovery Potion.
_zh: 拾取后吸取全场的经验结晶、灯油与源石锭。小怪低概率掉落，精英与 Boss 必掉磁铁或回复药剂。
_note: 校对：修正复数（Crystals, Ingots），统一术语（Elites and Bosses）

en: Restores 30% Max HP immediately upon pick up. Low drop rate from normal enemies, doubled when Leader HP is below 70%; Elites and Bosses are guaranteed to drop a Magnet or Recovery Potion.
_zh: 拾取后立即回复 30% 最大生命。小怪低概率掉落，队长生命低于 70% 时掉率翻倍；精英与 Boss 必掉磁铁或回复药剂。
_note: 校对：大小写修正，pick up不应大写

en: Appears periodically on the map, grants a Relic when opened. Some are disguised Chest Seaborn.
_zh: 地图上定期出现，打开后获得藏品。其中一部分是伪装的箱形恐鱼。

en: Nethersea Brand periodically appears on the ground and gradually expands. Standing on it inflicts Slow, continuous damage, and Nervous Impairment buildup; igniting a Guiding Beacon can dispel it.
_zh: 地面上周期性出现并逐渐扩大的溟痕。站在上面会减速、持续受伤并累积神经损伤；点燃引航灯标可以驱散。
_note: 校对：语法优化，Ignition of Guiding Beacon表达生硬

en: A small Guiding Beacon modeled after the lighthouses of Iberia, standing extinguished on the seabed. Step into the Beacon Ring to ignite it; the Beacon's light will dispel the surrounding Nethersea Brand, clear Nervous Impairment, and prevent Nethersea Brand from growing in this area temporarily.
_zh: 仿照伊比利亚灯塔做的小型引航灯标，熄灭着立在海床上。站进光圈点燃它，灯标的光会驱散周围的溟痕、清空神经损伤，这片地方也暂时不会再长出溟痕。

en: Wreckage from Abyssal ruins. Base blocks movement and linear projectiles, stops upon Dash collision.
_zh: 深海遗迹中的残骸。底座阻挡移动与直线弹道，冲刺碰撞后停止。
_note: 校对：语法优化，Move应为名词movement

en: Appears 3 times per run, staying for 60s each time. Approach to trade: Relic, Recovery, Lamp Oil, and Refresh.
_zh: 每次探索出现 3 次，每次停留 60 秒。靠近即可交易：藏品、回复、灯油与刷新。

en: Not yet discovered. Archived upon encounter.
_note: 校对：语法错误，修正为Archived upon encounter

en: Follows behind Leader to Command the squad. Does not attack, and cannot be attacked. Leader's initial movement speed and Pick Up values come from Doctor (no initial Dodge, gained through Cognitive Shaping, Upgrade, and Relic). HP, damage reduction, and Recovery are determined by Leader Operator. Light illuminates the area around Leader. Light extinguishes slightly when Leader is hit. Survival / Mobility / Synergy cards upon Upgrade are Command bonuses from Doctor to the squad. Rejection is recorded under Doctor, and can be viewed in the Stats panel.
_zh: 跟在队长身后指挥小队，不攻击，也不会受到攻击。队长的移速、拾取的初始值来自博士（初始没有闪避，靠认知塑造、升级与藏品获得），生命、减伤与回复由队长干员决定。灯火照亮的是队长身边，队长受击时灯火熄灭一截。升级时的生存 / 机动 / 协同卡是博士给小队的指挥加成；排异反应记在博士名下，可在属性面板查看。
_note: 校对：统一术语“movement speed”，修正不必要的大写（attack, hit, damage reduction），“排异反应”官译为Rejection

en: Growth cards appear in this order; Growth nodes each grant ATK +%d%%, Promotion enhances Normal Attack
_zh: 成长卡按此顺序出现；成长节点各带攻击 +%d%%，精英化强化普攻

keys: 灯火｜受击时损失，拾取灯油补充。< 30 暗淡：受到伤害更多；0 寂灭：每秒失去 3 点生命。

keys: 生命｜队长生命归零即探索失败。编队每多一名干员，最大生命 +{hp_per_member}%、回复 +{regen_per_member} / 秒。

keys: 通明｜灯火 ≥ 70：技力回复 +30%，拾取范围 +20%。暗淡时受到伤害 +{dark_taken}%，拾取范围 -30%，海嗣移速与接触伤害 +{dark_enemy}%。
en: Bright | Light ≥ 70: SP Recovery +30%, Pick Up Range +20%. When Dim, damage taken +{dark_taken}%, Pick Up Range -30%, Seaborn movement speed and contact damage +{dark_enemy}%.

keys: 照亮｜范围半径在 110 与 360 之间随灯火变化，灯火变弱时圈缩小、亮度不变。圈内敌人受到伤害 +{lit_bonus}%，通明时 +{lit_bonus_hi}%。
en: Illuminated | Range radius varies between 110 and 360 with Light; when Light weakens, the ring shrinks but brightness remains unchanged. Enemies within the ring have damage taken +{lit_bonus}%, +{lit_bonus_hi}% when Bright.

keys: 黑潮｜2:30 起安全区分 4 轮收缩，圈外持续受伤，看到「黑潮将至」就往白色虚线圈里走。
en: Black Tide | From 2:30, the Safe Zone shrinks in 4 phases. Take continuous damage outside the zone. Move into the white dashed circle when 'Black Tide Approaching' appears.

keys: 圆盘｜按 F（手柄 LB，触屏「指挥」键）打开，选队形与索敌偏好。
en: Disk | Press F (Controller LB, Touch 'Command' button) to open, select Formation and Targeting preference.

keys: 集火｜圆盘下半圈。点选一名精英或 Boss，全队攻击该目标；小怪不能选。
en: Focus Fire | Bottom half of the disc. Select an Elite or Boss, all allies attack the target; mobs cannot be selected.

keys: 加成｜突击、部署、集火时，出击的队友攻速 +{cmd_aspd}% · 技力回复 ×{cmd_sp}；随行时没有加成，但队友不会受伤。
en: Bonus | During Assault, Deploy, or Focus Fire, attacking allies gain ASPD +{cmd_aspd}% · SP recovery ×{cmd_sp}; no bonus during Follow, but allies will not take damage.

keys: 队形｜随行＝护卫阵型，队友按职业守在队长身边，不会受伤；突击＝队友按职业分头出击，耐力约 {cmd_stamina} 秒，耗尽自动归队。圆盘下半圈：部署＝点一个位置让队友落位，重装、近卫会挡住敌人。
en: Formation | Follow = Guard formation. Allies stay by Leader by class, taking no damage. Assault = Allies attack separately by class. Stamina lasts about {cmd_stamina}s, auto regroup when depleted. Lower half of disk: Deploy = Select a position for an ally to land. Defenders and Guards will block enemies.

keys: 操作｜按住选、松开确认，轻点则点选；打开时局内放慢。
en: Controls | Hold to select, release to confirm, tap to click; in-run time slows down when opened.

keys: 倒地｜突击和部署中的队友会被敌人与弹幕打伤，生命低于 30% 自动撤回队长身边；生命耗尽即倒地，{cmd_revive} 秒后复活。耐力耗尽后冷却，回到 {cmd_min}% 才能再次突击。
en: Downed | Allies in Assault and Deploy can be injured by enemies and projectiles. Auto retreat to Leader when HP is below 30%. Downed when HP is depleted, reviving after {cmd_revive}s. Cooldown triggers when stamina is depleted, requiring {cmd_min}% to Assault again.

keys: 瞄准｜普攻自动出手。按住鼠标左键朝光标打，手柄推右摇杆，触屏拖动瞄准键；松开即回到自动索敌。
en: Aim | Normal attack fires automatically. Hold left click to fire toward cursor, push right stick on controller, or drag aim button on touchscreen; release to return to auto targeting.

keys: 位置｜屏幕正下方：中间是队长与终结技（Q），左边是生命、灯火、冲刺，右边是队友与当前指令。
en: Position | Bottom of screen: Center is Leader with Ultimate (Q), left is HP, Light, Dash, right is allies and current command.

keys: 灯火｜生命下面的金色长条，右边是数值；30、70 处各有一道刻度。
en: Light | The gold bar below HP, value on the right; marks at 30 and 70.

keys: 终结技｜头像外圈是能量，满格转青；头像下是百分比。
en: Ultimate | The outer ring of the portrait is energy, turns cyan when full; percentage is below the portrait.

keys: 冲刺格｜「冲刺」左边的箭头：青色可用，用掉后从下往上回填。「连冲」多存一格，「迅捷」缩短冷却。
en: Dash Charges | Arrows left of 'Dash': cyan means available, refills from bottom to top when used. 'Multi-Dash' stores one extra charge, 'Swift' reduces cooldown.

keys: 队友｜头像下的细线是生命；倒地时变灰，读秒结束后复活。
en: Ally | The thin line under the portrait is HP; turns gray when downed, revives after the countdown ends.

keys: 指令牌｜当前指令：随行、突击、部署、集火。突击、部署沿边框计作战时限；集火目标倒下即结束。
en: Command Card | Current command: Follow, Assault, Deploy, Focus Fire. Assault and Deploy count time limit along the border; Focus Fire ends when the target is defeated.

keys: 出现｜2:00、5:00、8:00，只停留 60 秒，屏幕边缘的金色箭头指向他。
en: Appearance | 2:00, 5:00, 8:00. Stays for 60s only. Golden arrows at the screen edge point to him.

keys: 购买｜靠近即可用源石锭购买藏品、急救包与灯油。
en: Purchase | Approach to buy Relics, First-aid Kits, and Lamp Oil with Originium Ingots.

keys: 提醒｜最后 15 秒有横幅提醒，倒计时变红。每次到访可消耗源石锭刷新一次货架（按 F）。
en: Reminder | A banner reminder appears in the last 15s, and the countdown turns red. Can consume Originium Ingots to refresh stock once per visit (Press F).

keys: 熔铸｜最后一位商人离开后，剩下的和之后获得的源石锭自动熔铸为全队伤害（每 15 枚 +1%，上限 +20%）。
en: Smelt | After the last merchant leaves, remaining and subsequently obtained Originium Ingots are automatically smelted into squad damage (+1% per 15 ingots, up to +20%).

keys: 节点卡｜通关结局一后，中 Boss 打完会翻节点卡；结局线藏在「不期而遇」里。
en: Node Card | After clearing Ending 1, defeating the Mid-Boss reveals a node card. Ending routes are hidden in 'Encounter'.

keys: 路口｜3:30、7:00 的中 Boss 全部倒下后各翻一次（最晚 6:30、8:40），三张卡只露类型，选一张翻开即生效。
en: Intersection | Flips once after all Mid-Bosses at 3:30 and 7:00 are defeated (latest 6:30 and 8:40). Three cards only reveal their type; select one to flip and it takes effect immediately.

keys: 结局线｜两条结局线的入口每局必有，但翻开前不知道是哪件事；达成过的结局，入口卡背描上该结局的颜色。
en: Ending Route | Entrances to both Ending routes are guaranteed per run, but the event is unknown until revealed; for achieved Endings, the entrance card back is outlined in that Ending's color.

keys: 走向｜结局只看拿到的信物。当前走向显示在右上角藏品栏下方与 Tab 面板，9:00 有终局预告。
en: Route | Ending depends solely on tokens obtained. Current route is displayed below the Relic bar in the top right and on the Tab panel; endgame warning at 9:00.

en: Ending | Four Endings each have a different Final Boss. Once achieved, they are added to the 'Ending' tab in Archive.

en: Elite | Has a golden halo and HP bar. Drops Originium Ingots when defeated, with a chance to drop a chest. The 'Focus Fire' disc allows the whole squad to focus attacks on it.

keys: Boss｜中 Boss 在场时暂停缩圈，普通海嗣照常刷新；看清地面的预警圈，冲刺躲开，冲刺中无敌。

en: Final Boss | Appears at 10:00. Other Seaborn will no longer spawn after its appearance. Defeat it to complete the run.
